lines.differs: Tougher on AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: fee is higher at USD 52,000 but lacks the 45-day payment deadline and formal dispute resolution process.
Easier for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: higher total fee of USD 52,000 versus USD 33,000 and explicitly includes travel expense reimbursement at cost.
Tougher on AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ is the service provider here receiving USD 52,000, whereas it was the payor in the previous agreement.
Broadly like Crestline Retail Inc: both require 3-year post-termination confidentiality, though this lacks Crestline's indefinite protection for trade secrets.
Broadly like Rohan Iyer: 3-year survival period is similar, but this version omits specific restrictions on downloading data to personal devices.
Broadly like Al Noor Hospitality Group: both impose mutual confidentiality and restricted use, but this version omits the detailed list of specific confidential examples.
Broadly like Sunrise Foods: AtliQ retains background technology and grants a perpetual license while transferring ownership of custom deliverables upon full payment.
Broadly like PayTrack Technologies: ownership of custom deliverables transfers only upon full payment, with AtliQ retaining its pre-existing tools and know-how.
Broadly like Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: custom deliverables transfer only after full payment, ensuring AtliQ retains ownership until the USD 52,000 is received.
Tougher on AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: the liability cap includes an exception for confidentiality breaches, which was not present in the previous agreement.
Broadly like Rohan Iyer: both cap liability at 12 months of fees with exceptions for confidentiality, though this includes wilful misconduct instead of fraud.
Broadly like Crestline Retail Inc: both use a 12-month rolling fee cap with confidentiality exceptions, but this excludes an exception for general indemnification.
Easier for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: mutual indemnity is limited to IP and data/legal breaches, omitting broad coverage for gross negligence or fraud.
Same as Al Noor Hospitality Group: mutual indemnities cover third-party IP infringement for deliverables and client data respectively.
Broadly like Acme Retail Group: both cover IP infringement, but this version narrows AtliQ’s risk by removing indemnity for gross negligence or confidentiality breaches.
Tougher on AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: adds specific compliance requirements for UAE and Saudi data laws and restricts data transfers outside the cloud environment.
Broadly like Al Noor Hospitality Group: both require UAE law compliance and restrict data transfers, but this version omits the 48-hour breach notification.
Tougher on AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: introduces Saudi and UAE data law compliance and restricts data transfers, though it lacks the 24-hour notification duty.
Tougher on AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: moves jurisdiction from the international DIFC courts to onshore Dubai courts and removes the mandatory negotiation period.
Broadly like Brightwater Insurance Inc: shifts the legal framework and venue from England to Dubai onshore courts and UAE federal law.
Broadly like Northwind Logistics: replaces English law and London arbitration with UAE/Dubai law and exclusive jurisdiction of the onshore Dubai courts.
